sn14.12:2.3: kāmapariyesanaṃ bhikkhave pariyesamāno assutavā puthujjano tīhi ṭhānehi micchā paṭipajjati kāyena vācāya manasā.

sn14.12:4.2: vihiṃsāpariyesanaṃ bhikkhave pariyesamāno assutavā puthujjano tīhi ṭhānehi micchā paṭipajjati kāyena vācāya manasā.

sn14.12:5.2: evameva kho bhikkhave yo hi koci samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā uppannaṃ visamagataṃ akusalasaññaṃ 1 na khippameva pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti so diṭṭheva 2 dhamme dukkhaṃ viharati savighātaṃ saupāyāsaṃ sapariḷāhaṃ
sn14.12:5.3: kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā.
